Nominal declaration checks reject mixed revision families. No Identity provisioning is exposed.

Snapshot and receipt reads share the validated MemberView decoder. Stable Participant/Identity IDs, closed kind, role, membership epoch, active flag and nullable removal reason produce an immutable typed receipt view. The returned handle retains its observed Conversation revision; refresh is a separate currently authorized read.

Receipt views grant no current authority and cannot cross a successor target membership epoch. Readmission preserves stable IDs while creating a new epoch. Old journal cursors remain unusable; no history sharing is implied.
